annotations.title: Take Kai Out of a Meeting

description: Have Kai leave a video meeting it is in, or stop trying to join one. Kai drops out of the live call for everyone in it and stops taking notes; this cannot be undone, and joining again takes a new join_meeting request. Notes taken so far are kept and can be read with get_meeting.

business_id.description: Business ID (required when the token can access several businesses).

id.description: Meeting id from join_meeting or get_meeting.
